fact: Article 39 of Ordonnance-loi n° 23/010 of 13 March 2023 (Digital Code) states that administrations exchange electronically among themselves all information or data strictly necessary to process a request, and that the government sets up a secure intranet between central and provincial administrations.
title: Ordonnance-loi n° 23/010 du 13 mars 2023 portant Code du numérique
